items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Wolves live and hunt in groups called packs. The pack works together to chase and catch large animals like deer. A pack is led by the strongest male and female, called the alpha pair.'

Text B: 'Wolves communicate with each other by howling. A wolf howl can be heard from miles away. Wolves also use body language and scent to send messages to their pack.'

Identify one similarity and one difference between these two texts. Which text gives more information about how wolves behave as a group?
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts describe behaviors of wolves living in packs. Difference: Text A focuses on how wolves hunt and who leads the pack. Text B focuses on how wolves communicate. Text A gives more information about how wolves behave as a group because it describes pack structure and cooperative hunting, which are directly about group behavior.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Marie Curie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize. She discovered two elements: radium and polonium. Her research on radioactivity changed science forever.'

Text B: 'Marie Curie faced many challenges as a scientist. She was often not taken seriously because she was a woman. Despite this, she earned two Nobel Prizes, in physics and chemistry.'

What is one thing both texts agree on? What is one detail that only Text B includes?
items.answer: Both texts say that Marie Curie won the Nobel Prize (Text A says one, Text B correctly notes two). One detail only Text B includes is that she faced challenges because of her gender and was often not taken seriously. Text A focuses on her discoveries, not her personal struggles.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The Amazon rainforest produces about 20 percent of the world's oxygen. It is home to over 40,000 plant species and 1,300 bird species.'

Text B: 'The Amazon rainforest is being destroyed at a rapid rate. Large areas are cut down each year for farming and cattle ranching. Scientists say this threatens thousands of species with extinction.'

One text focuses on what the rainforest is; the other focuses on what is happening to it. Identify which is which and explain what a reader gains by reading both.
items.answer: Text A focuses on what the rainforest is, describing its size, oxygen production, and the number of species it supports. Text B focuses on what is happening to the rainforest, describing deforestation and its consequences. A reader gains a complete understanding by reading both: Text A shows why the rainforest is valuable, and Text B shows why protecting it is urgent. Without Text A, a reader would not know what is at risk. Without Text B, a reader would not know the rainforest is in danger.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Earthquakes cause the ground to shake. Buildings and bridges can be damaged or destroyed. Earthquakes near the ocean can cause tsunamis.'

Text B: 'Scientists track earthquakes using instruments called seismographs. The Richter scale measures how strong an earthquake is. Earthquakes below 3.0 are rarely felt by people.'

Identify one similarity and one difference. Then explain which text would be more useful to a scientist studying earthquakes.
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts are about earthquakes. Difference: Text A describes the effects of earthquakes on the environment and people, while Text B describes how scientists measure and study earthquakes. Text B would be more useful to a scientist because it describes the tools and systems scientists actually use (seismographs, the Richter scale) and gives specific data about earthquake strength.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Abraham Lincoln was the 16th president of the United States. He led the country through the Civil War and worked to end slavery.'

Text B: 'Abraham Lincoln grew up in a log cabin in Kentucky. His family was very poor, and he taught himself to read by firelight.'

Identify one similarity and one difference. Which text gives more information about Lincoln as a person, and which gives more information about Lincoln as a leader?
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts are about Abraham Lincoln. Difference: Text A focuses on his role as president and his major political actions, while Text B focuses on his childhood and personal circumstances. Text B gives more information about Lincoln as a person, describing his poverty and determination to learn. Text A gives more information about Lincoln as a leader, describing his presidency and work to end slavery.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The Sahara Desert is the largest hot desert on Earth. It covers most of northern Africa. Temperatures can reach over 130 degrees Fahrenheit during the day.'

Text B: 'Despite its harsh conditions, the Sahara Desert has wildlife. Camels, scorpions, and sand foxes have all adapted to survive with little water and extreme heat.'

Identify one similarity and one difference. Then explain how the two texts work together to give a fuller picture of the Sahara Desert.
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts describe the extreme conditions of the Sahara Desert. Difference: Text A focuses on the desert's size, location, and temperature. Text B focuses on the animals that live there and how they have adapted. The two texts work together because Text A establishes how harsh the desert is, and Text B then shows that life exists even in those extreme conditions. Together, they give a picture of both the environment and the life it contains.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Recycling paper saves trees. Making new paper from recycled material uses less energy than making it from fresh wood.'

Text B: 'Recycling plastic helps reduce pollution. Plastic that is not recycled often ends up in oceans and can harm sea animals.'

Both texts are about recycling, but they discuss different materials. Identify one thing both texts agree on and one way they differ.
items.answer: Both texts agree that recycling is beneficial and helps protect the environment. They differ in the material they focus on: Text A discusses recycling paper and its benefits for saving trees and energy, while Text B discusses recycling plastic and the harm plastic causes when it ends up in the ocean.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Hummingbirds are very small birds. They beat their wings up to 80 times per second, which is why they make a humming sound. They can fly forward, backward, and even hover in place.'

Text B: 'Hummingbirds eat flower nectar. Their long beaks are perfectly shaped to reach deep inside flowers. As they feed, they also carry pollen from flower to flower.'

Identify one similarity and two differences between the two texts.
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts describe special traits of hummingbirds. Differences: (1) Text A focuses on how hummingbirds move and fly, while Text B focuses on how hummingbirds eat. (2) Text A explains the physical skill of flying (wing speed, directions), while Text B explains the hummingbird's role in helping plants through pollination.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The International Space Station orbits Earth about 250 miles above the surface. Astronauts from many countries live and work there for months at a time.'

Text B: 'Living on the International Space Station is challenging. Astronauts must exercise for two hours every day to keep their muscles strong because there is no gravity in space.'

Identify one similarity and one difference. Which text gives a more complete picture of what it is like to live on the space station?
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts are about the International Space Station and the astronauts who work there. Difference: Text A describes where the station is and who lives there. Text B describes what daily life is like there (the challenges of no gravity and the need to exercise). Text B gives a more complete picture of what it is like to live there because it describes the specific challenges astronauts face each day.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Tornadoes are measured using the Enhanced Fujita Scale. An EF0 tornado has winds between 65 and 85 miles per hour. An EF5 tornado has winds over 200 miles per hour and can cause catastrophic damage.'

Text B: 'Most tornadoes in the United States happen in an area called Tornado Alley. This includes states like Texas, Oklahoma, and Kansas. Tornado season is usually from spring through early summer.'

Identify one similarity and two differences. If you had to choose one text to learn about tornado safety, neither text would be fully helpful. Explain why.
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts provide factual information about tornadoes. Differences: (1) Text A focuses on measuring tornado strength using the Fujita Scale. Text B focuses on where and when tornadoes happen most. (2) Text A gives specific wind speed numbers. Text B gives geographic and seasonal information. Neither text is fully helpful for tornado safety because Text A only gives measurement data and Text B only tells you where and when they happen most. Neither text explains what to do during a tornado or how to prepare.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Ancient Egyptians used pictures called hieroglyphics to write. Each picture stood for a word or sound. Hieroglyphics were carved into stone temples and tombs.'

Text B: 'Hieroglyphics were a mystery for hundreds of years. In 1799, a stone called the Rosetta Stone was discovered. It had the same message written in hieroglyphics and Greek, which helped scientists decode hieroglyphics.'

Identify one similarity and one difference. Which text tells you more about how historians learned to understand ancient Egyptian writing?
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts are about Egyptian hieroglyphics. Difference: Text A explains what hieroglyphics are and how they were used, while Text B explains the history of how modern people were able to decode them. Text B tells you more about how historians learned to understand hieroglyphics because it describes the discovery of the Rosetta Stone and explains how it was used to crack the code.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Black bears are found across North America. They are excellent climbers and often search for food in forests and near camping areas.'

Text B: 'Black bears eat a wide variety of foods. They eat berries, nuts, insects, and fish. In fall, they eat large amounts of food to prepare for winter hibernation.'

Identify one similarity and one difference. Which text gives more information about black bears' diet?
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts describe black bear behavior related to survival. Difference: Text A focuses on where bears live and their climbing ability, while Text B focuses on what they eat and their preparation for hibernation. Text B gives more information about diet because it lists specific foods (berries, nuts, insects, fish) and explains why they eat so much in fall.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Astronaut Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the moon. On July 20, 1969, he stepped onto the lunar surface and said, 'That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.'

Text B: 'The Apollo 11 mission that landed on the moon was the result of years of work by thousands of scientists and engineers. The rocket used, the Saturn V, was the largest ever built at the time.'

Identify one similarity and one difference. Which text focuses on the individual and which focuses on the team effort?
items.answer: Similarity: Both texts are about the first moon landing in 1969. Difference: Text A focuses on Neil Armstrong as the individual who first stepped on the moon and his famous quote. Text B focuses on the team of scientists and engineers and the technology used. Text A focuses on the individual, while Text B focuses on the team effort that made the landing possible.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'Monarch butterflies migrate up to 3,000 miles each year from Canada and the United States to their winter home in Mexico.'

Text B: 'Monarch butterflies are in danger. The forests where they spend the winter in Mexico are being cut down. Milkweed plants, which monarchs need to survive, are disappearing from many areas.'

Identify one thing both texts agree on and explain how the two texts together give a more complete picture of monarch butterflies than either one alone.
items.answer: Both texts agree that monarch butterflies travel to Mexico (Text A about migration, Text B about winter habitat). The two texts together give a more complete picture because Text A shows the impressive journey monarchs make, which helps readers understand what is at stake in Text B. Without Text A, readers might not appreciate the importance of Mexico's forests to butterflies that travel 3,000 miles to reach them. Together, one text shows the marvel of migration and the other shows why protecting the destination is critical.

items.prompt:
Read both articles below.

Text A: 'The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef. It stretches over 1,400 miles along the coast of Australia and is home to thousands of species of fish, turtles, and corals.'

Text B: 'The Great Barrier Reef is threatened by warming oceans. When water gets too warm, corals expel the algae living inside them and turn white, a process called coral bleaching. Bleached corals can die if temperatures stay high.'

What do both texts tell you? What does each text add that the other does not? Which gives more information about the reef's future?
items.answer: Both texts tell you about the Great Barrier Reef, one of the world's notable natural features. Text A adds information about its size and the variety of life it supports. Text B adds information about the threat of ocean warming and coral bleaching. Text B gives more information about the reef's future because it explains a current danger (warming temperatures, bleaching, possible death of corals) that could affect whether the reef survives at all.
